about: What each provider slot has recorded against the real service, per route (router design section 11, release gate; lanes E2-R3b, E2-R3c; ruling 125 item 2). tools/release_gate/check_router_release.py reads it with tools/model_caps/models.toml: a route marked releasable fails while a synthetic wire fixture is left for it or a request-shape feature its rows allow has no recorded 2xx. A citation is a repo path or 'P:<path>' (a program evidence file outside the repo). A waiver is {why, until}; its key is one item, a folder ending in '/' or a glob, and every item it covers is printed. Ruling 125 item 2: Anthropic direct is releasable with waivers until R10 (design section 12) records each item; every routed route is not releasable until R10.
